    Baoth

    📜 Historical Records¶

    🐉 The Dragon Dynasty¶

    Only the ruling dynasty of Baoth was draconic. The king — Goldenborn — was a space-evolved dragon, a being whose species was born not on any planet but in the cold void between stars. The dragon dynasty maintained power through the Golden Pact: a legal-mystical framework that bound every citizen to the crown through blood oaths. The 99% non-dragon population lived, worked, and fought for a ruler who was not their own kind — a system that, remarkably, held for over five centuries.

    ⚔️ The Last War of Donblond'werv (967 BGD)¶

    Before Baoth's rise, the continent of Donblond'werv (later renamed Erisdar) was dominated by sprawling human empires. These empires, at the end of the Human Age, had become corrupt beyond repair — their institutions hollow, their leadership parasitic. Baoth, wielding draconic power and a coalition of species who had been subjugated under human rule, crushed them in the Last War. The human empires fell. Baoth rose. The continent was never again ruled purely by humans.

    🔥 The Fall — The Demonic War and the Explosion¶

    By the 5th century BGD, Hybrian Shadows had spent over two millennia infiltrating the institutions of Ge'or. Baoth — the most powerful state on the continent — was their prime target. They infiltrated the upper echelon with the goal of possessing Goldenborn himself.

    Kirivis, the Demon King, discovered the plot. He launched the Demonic War — a 45-year campaign to reach Goldenborn and save him.

    On the final day (421 BGD), Kirivis reached Goldenborn, but was betrayed by Rulfred — a Shadow posing as Baoth's greatest hero. Rulfred beheaded Kirivis and became king.

    Kirivis's daughter Nethra received a modified Shadow device from the tree spirits of the Lyrical Forest. She infiltrated the castle through the sewers, confronted Rulfred, and activated the device. The explosion obliterated the entire kingdom. The crater filled with water, creating the Sea of Leviathan.

    Rulfred survived. He took Goldenborn's corpse. The Hybrians unleashed the Leviathan to enforce quarantine on the ruins.

    🌫️ The Aftermath¶

    Baoth was never rebuilt. Its ruins sit on an island in the Sea of Leviathan. Three forces now guard what remains:

    • The Mystical Forest — the corrupted woodland ring, unclaimed by any nation
    • The Leviathan — Hybrian warden, unleashed after the explosion
    • Dragon Yaldabaoth — Rulfred wearing Goldenborn's corpse
